question: Should ClawHub standardize on a plural `clawhub skills` namespace, extend the existing singular `clawhub skill` namespace, or keep root-level skill commands as compatibility-first aliases?
rationale: This is a user-facing CLI taxonomy and compatibility decision, not a broken existing behavior with one obvious fix; changing command placement can affect scripts, docs, and release messaging.

options.title: Add grouped namespace with compatibility aliases
options.body: Choose the stable skill namespace, move primary help/docs there, and keep existing root commands as aliases or documented deprecations for upgrade safety.

options.title: Extend existing singular `skill` group
options.body: Put the broader skill operations under `clawhub skill` to avoid introducing a parallel plural namespace, while deciding which root aliases remain.

options.title: Defer consolidation
options.body: Keep the root commands as the supported surface until plugin/package CLI taxonomy settles further.

recommendation.title: Add grouped namespace with compatibility aliases
recommendation.body: Choose the stable skill namespace, move primary help/docs there, and keep existing root commands as aliases or documented deprecations for upgrade safety.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the request and has the strongest recent history on the CLI command surface and release snapshot that currently defines it.
